label: Applying directly to a Swiss university for autumn 2027

milestones.label: ETH Zurich bachelor applications open
milestones.note: ETH publishes day and month only; the year is read for autumn 2027 entry.

milestones.label: EPFL and the University of Zurich close for bachelor applications
milestones.note: Both publish 30 April with no year; read here for autumn 2027. EPFL opens in mid-November and the CHF 150 fee is due by the same day. The University of Zurich opens on 1 January and its later July window is for Swiss certificates only.

milestones.label: Every other university's own closing date
milestones.note: No national portal and no national date. Each university sets its own; most fall in spring, before IB results.

notes: Covers every listed institution: all Swiss universities and private institutions take applications directly.
The ETH entrance-exam timetable for autumn 2027 (apply by 31 March 2026) has passed and is recorded on the country profile, not here.
